summary: The test suite is exceptionally high quality. It thoroughly covers all requirements using a comprehensive, multi-layered testing strategy: pure unit tests for matrix logic, CLI subprocess tests, workflow structure validation (including actionlint), and full end-to-end integration tests using 'act'. Edge cases, boundary conditions (like max-size), and malformed inputs are rigorously tested. The organization is clean, well-commented, and perfectly suited to catch any regressions.
